items.summary: Microsoft's October Patch Tuesday fixed over 1,400 security bugs, including CVE-2026-96951, a Mark of the Web bypass exploited in the wild that lets a malicious file skip Protected View warnings when opened.
items.title: Microsoft fixes exploited Mark of the Web bypass in record Patch Tuesday

items.summary: South Korea's financial regulator said hacking incidents have been confirmed at 16 financial firms, with around 100,000 cases of leaked personal data so far, and it is investigating whether AI was involved in the attacks.
items.title: South Korea confirms hacking at 16 financial firms, 100,000 data leaks

items.summary: GitLab shipped emergency releases 19.4.2, 19.3.5 and 19.2.8 to fix CVE-2026-97229, an integer overflow in the CI/CD regex compiler that lets an unauthenticated attacker run arbitrary code on self-managed servers; Rapid7 independently reproduced the exploit.
items.title: GitLab patches CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated remote code execution flaw

items.summary: CISA is urging immediate Ivanti Connect Secure updates as honeypots logged 105 exploit attempts against CVE-2026-104935; Volexity observed criminal group UTA0576 achieving unauthenticated root-level code execution on October 3.
items.title: CISA urges Ivanti Connect Secure updates as honeypots log 105 exploit attempts

items.summary: Meta notified around 1,500 people, mostly employees, after hackers accessed some of its GitHub repositories using stolen employee logins; the company says no Meta products had security flaws and internal systems were not breached.
items.title: Meta warns 1,500 people after hackers accessed GitHub repos via stolen logins

items.summary: Ransomware group SafePay has been trying to extort T-Systems since October 5; Deutsche Telekom says only a small test system was affected and the stolen data, mostly presentation slides and log files, contains no sensitive information.
items.title: SafePay ransomware targets Deutsche Telekom's T-Systems in alleged breach
